scope: Read the full current English prose and Chinese README; suggest only small wording changes to S/G terminology and evaluation-cost claims. No source prose was edited.
overall_assessment: Existing evidence qualifiers and platform limitations are appropriate. No broad rewrite, new experiment, mathematical change, table change, reference change or numerical-ratio change is recommended.

recommendations.purpose: Name the measured quantity and avoid interpreting nfev as elapsed time.
recommendations.before: These measure the cost of each observed endpoint; the different objective values prevent interpreting them as times to the same solution.
recommendations.after: These counts describe function evaluations to the observed endpoints; differing final objective values prevent an equal-quality cost comparison.

recommendations.purpose: Keep the exact ratios while stating the shared-initial-point pairing, both-G selection, dimensions and function-evaluation denominator.
recommendations.before: Restricting to paired starts where both attain G leaves 5, 3, and 4 pairs; the median per-pair nfev(CG)/nfev(BFGS) ratios are 1.24, 2.97, and 3.91.
recommendations.after: Among pairs sharing an initial point, both methods meet G in 5, 3, and 4 pairs for d=2,10,20; the corresponding median function-evaluation ratios nfev(CG)/nfev(BFGS) are 1.24, 2.97, and 3.91.

recommendations.purpose: Avoid confusing optimization stopping criteria with the separate finite-difference gradient checks.
recommendations.before: Hence 43 successful gradient tests correspond to non-global endpoints, not solutions with objective near zero.
recommendations.after: Hence 43 runs meet the gradient tolerance while missing the global-objective target.

recommendations.purpose: Use the same terminology for the Rosenbrock count.
recommendations.before: These four endpoints explain why 30 successful Rosenbrock gradient tests yield only 26 global-target hits.
recommendations.after: These four endpoints explain why 30 Rosenbrock runs meet the gradient tolerance but only 26 meet the global-objective target.

readme_optional_clarifications.suggested_zh: 正文中的 S 表示公共梯度阈值达标（stationary），G 表示已知全局目标差距阈值命中（global_hit）；两者与原始 solver_success 分别记录。
文中 1.24、2.97、3.91 分别对应 d=2、10、20：在相同初始点且 CG 与 BFGS 均满足 G 的 5、3、4 组配对中，它们是 nfev(CG)/nfev(BFGS) 的中位数，仅用于函数评估成本比较；迭代数与墙钟时间须另行比较。
